chunks: Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
“Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled that for the backbone there is the blood-money.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam Ali عليه السلام as the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.ٱلدِّيَةَ: the prescribed blood-money compensation for injury

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on diyah for injury to the backbone in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding injury to the backbone. It establishes that such an injury entails diyah, placing the report within the jurisprudence of bodily injuries and retaliation.
